map.为什么屏蔽了还是被搜到？: Why was it still indexed after being blocked?
map.因为 robots.txt 只规范「抓取」，不禁止「索引」：若有外部链接指向该页: Because robots.txt only governs crawling, not indexing: if an external link points to the page, a search engine may still index it (shown as a "not crawled" result). To truly stay out of the index use a noindex response header or meta tag; for sensitive content you must require login authentication, since robots.txt would instead expose the path.
